title: trichophyllum capitatum
intro: Trichophyllum capitatum, commonly known as the 'Cushion Moss', is a type of non-vascular, green alga found in damp environments. The health benefits of Trichophyllum capitatum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in Trichophyllum capitatum include polysaccharides, lipids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
